Landing.readyDesc: Join thousands of players in Obour City. Book your pitch or organize a public match in under 60 seconds.
Landing.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about booking, payments, and playing.
Landing.faq1A: When you select a slot, it is locked exclusively for you for 15 minutes to allow time to complete the deposit payment via Vodafone Cash or InstaPay.
Landing.faq2Q: What happens after uploading the receipt?
Landing.faq2A: The stadium manager verifies your receipt and confirms your booking within minutes. You receive a digital QR pass.
Landing.faq3Q: Can I host a public match and split costs?
Landing.faq3A: Yes! You can set your booking type as "Public" and open it for players in Obour to join your match.

Cookies.title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.sec1Desc: Cookies are small pieces of text sent by your web browser by a website you visit. A cookie file is stored in your web browser and allows the Service or a third-party to recognize you and make your next visit easier and the Service more useful to you.
Cookies.sec2Desc: When you use and access the Service, we may place a number of cookies files in your web browser. We use cookies to enable certain functions of the Service, to provide analytics, to store your preferences, and to enable authenticated sessions.
Cookies.sec3Desc: Some cookies are essential for the operation of our platform. For example, we use cookies to keep you logged in securely while you browse our site.
Cookies.sec4Desc: If you'd like to delete cookies or instruct your web browser to delete or refuse cookies, please visit the help pages of your web browser. Please note, however, that if you delete cookies or refuse to accept them, you might not be able to use all of the features we offer.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.sec1Desc: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, update your profile, or book a pitch.
Privacy.sec2Desc: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, as well as to process your bookings and transactions.
Privacy.sec3Desc: We may share your information with pitch owners and admins solely for the purpose of fulfilling your booking requests.
Privacy.sec4Desc: We implement robust security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.sec1Desc: By accessing or using EGFootball5, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you disagree with any part of the terms, you may not access the service.
Terms.sec2Desc: You are responsible for safeguarding the password that you use to access the service and for any activities or actions under your password.
Terms.sec3Desc: All bookings are subject to availability and confirmation by the pitch owner. Deposits must be paid as specified, and failure to do so may result in cancellation of your booking.
Terms.sec4Desc: Users must conduct themselves respectfully. Any abuse of the booking system, including creating fake bookings, will result in account termination.
